narrative_purpose: Teaches that the canopy is the forest's richest, least-explored floor — a garden with its own soil: epiphytes growing on branches, their debris building aerial soil mats, and the host tree growing roots out of its own limbs to drink from them.
subject: A close naturalist study of a single great horizontal tree branch high in the canopy, seen in cutaway: its upper surface is thick with cushions of moss, ferns, and orchid-like epiphytes; their accumulated debris forms a dark mat of soil running along the branch; fine roots grow downward out of the host branch itself, penetrating into that aerial soil mat; small insects and one tiny climbing animal are tucked among the epiphytes; the background falls away into bright hazy open air to signal great height.
scene: A high-canopy close-up of one branch as a living garden, the rest of the forest dissolving into bright haze far below and behind.
camera: A close, slightly raised three-quarter view of the branch, shallow depth so the aerial garden is sharp and the background soft.
light: Bright, airy high-canopy daylight with a cool cast; the epiphyte cushions and the host roots picked out clearly, the deep background washed pale with height-haze.
palette: Living teal and Pandora cyan in the foliage and roots, soft pale haze behind, void-indigo only in the cutaway shadow of the branch.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate with diagrammatic clarity, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp and intricate on the epiphytes, the soil mat, and the descending host roots; soft and pale in the distant background.
composition: The branch running across the frame, the aerial garden on its upper surface and the descending roots below it, open hazy space above and beside framed by deep negative space.
consistency_notes: Earth-science concept (epiphytes, aerial soil, canopy roots) rendered in the book's cool palette so it sits beside the Pandoran plates; the branch-as-garden and the roots-from-the-branch must read clearly; generous deep indigo negative space.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
